assignments.why: Measures an LLM evaluator failing inside a self-refinement loop: its scores rise while human-judged quality stalls.
A judging method (Simulated Annotators confidence) whose unconfident cases cascade from Mistral-7B to GPT-4 to humans under a calibrated threshold, with abstention as the core mechanism.

assignments.note: 2024-08 Can unconfident LLM annotations be used for confident conclusions
assignments.why: LLM annotations as labels, with human labels routed to the cases where the LLM is unconfident, to cut human labels while keeping valid statistical estimates.
A reward model trained to write a critique then score, trained pairwise on preference data.
A verifier trained by next-token prediction with CoT rationales and vote averaging.
Human-screened coding-agent task suite meant to remove unfair tests, later shown to have verifier failures.
Fine-tunes an LLM judge on synthetic contrast pairs, iteratively retraining on its own correct traces (a self-improving judge).

assignments.note: 2024-09 Language Models Learn to Mislead Humans via RLHF
assignments.why: Studies RLHF and measures how it raises human evaluators' false-positive rate, an evaluator failure.
Meta-benchmark showing LLM-judge preferences track style rather than concrete measures of quality.

assignments.note: 2024-09 Training language models to win debates with self-play improves judge accuracy
assignments.why: Debate (self-play-trained debaters vs consultancy) as a way to raise judge accuracy.
An agentic judge that inspects the evaluated agent's workspace and trajectory, introduced with the DevAI benchmark of AI-dev tasks.
Benchmark of malicious agent tasks with synthetic tools for measuring agent harmfulness.
Red-teaming agent that generates adversarial jailbreak attacks and grows its strategy library from past attacks.

assignments.note: 2024-10 Cheating automatic LLM benchmarks null models
assignments.why: Shows a constant adversarial output fools LLM-judged benchmarks, an adversarial-cue robustness study of judges.
Meta-evaluation benchmark of LLM judges and reward models on objectively labelled hard pairs.
Quantifies 12 judge biases by perturbation, including position and other content-preserving presentation changes.

assignments.note: 2024-10 Limits to scalable evaluation at the frontier
assignments.why: Theory on using judge labels plus ground truth (debiasing/PPI), bounding how far judges can reduce required labels with valid estimates.
Suite of 75 Kaggle competitions scoring ML-engineering agents against human leaderboards.

assignments.note: 2024-10 PPE How to Evaluate Reward Models for RLHF
assignments.why: Meta-evaluation benchmark for reward models tied to downstream RLHF outcomes.
Benchmark measuring reward models' style bias and sensitivity to subtle content errors across ~40 RMs.
Audit of SWE-bench passing patches exposing solution leakage and weak tests (verifier failures), plus a rebuilt set.
Measures GPT-4 judge self-preference and links it to perplexity.
Scalar reward models trained on a curated pairwise preference dataset.
A judging method where an LLM-generated instruction-specific checklist is used by the judge to score responses.
Survey of how to build reliable LLM judges that also proposes a reliability meta-evaluation benchmark.

assignments.note: 2024-11 Critic-RM Self-Generated Critiques Boost Reward Modeling
assignments.why: Reward model jointly trained on self-generated, filtered critiques and reward prediction.
Survey and taxonomy of LLM-as-a-judge: what to judge, how to judge, how to benchmark.
Crowdsourced pairwise arena whose Elo leaderboard ranks LLM judges, a judge-the-judge meta-evaluation.
RLVR replaces a judge with programmatic verification of answers as the reward.
Meta-evaluation benchmark of vision-language generative reward models, finding failures in basic perception.
